notes: No: every tiling of a rectangle by >= 2 pairwise incomparable rectangles has a tile of aspect ratio >= 2 (>= sqrt 2 if rotation is not allowed). Incomparability makes short sides strictly anti-ordered with long sides, so with max aspect ratio rho < 2 all sides lie in [m, rho m); then at the corner of the lower-left tile A, the right neighbour has height h(A) or the upper neighbour has width w(A) (a gap below rho m - m < m cannot hold a tile), and equal sides make two tiles comparable. Outside Lean: the whole argument (no Lean; formalising general rectangle tilings not done).
